entities.name: Carlo Bascapè
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Carlo Maria Bascapè was an Italian Roman Catholic prelate and scholar who served as Bishop of Novara from 1593 until his death. He was a close friend of Saint Charles Borromeo and assumed the first half of his religious name in honor of him.
